1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a Junior Graphic Designer and wanted to apply, as my background in corporate communications and template building at Ascent Business Solutions lines up closely with your marketing team's needs.

In my current role, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives including presentations, banners, and internal communications while working directly with management stakeholders. I also built reusable design templates that cut turnaround time for repetitive work.

My branding kit for the AT Creation startup demonstrates my foundational design and asset organization skills, which you can see in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Could we schedule a brief call to discuss how I can support your global marketing initiatives?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
